Container.Name: pdfcraft
Container.Overview: PdfCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Acrobat in Rust, from the ArtCraft Crafting Apps. The open-source PDF workbench: read, organize, combine, split and secure. This container serves its browser (WebAssembly) build with nginx. All work happens in your browser: Open/Save use the browser file picker and downloads, so nothing is stored on the server and no volume is needed. WebGPU and clipboard APIs require a secure context, so reach it over HTTPS (for example via Unraid's Tailscale integration with Tailscale Serve, or a reverse proxy) or via localhost. Early alpha software.
